attributes.context: The sentence appears in Article Four - Management Clause, which reserves usual and customary management rights to the Company, including managing the plant and operations and directing the working force.

extraction_text: Nothing in this Agreement shall be construed to restrict the right of management to adopt, install, or operate new or improved equipment or methods of operation.

attributes.context: The clause appears in Article Twenty-Three - Safety and Sanitation, which establishes a joint Union-Company Safety Committee with two representatives from each side and provides for monthly meetings, review of safety suggestions or violations, and personal inspections of problem areas when deemed necessary.

extraction_text: The Union Safety Committee shall inspect all new machines/operations prior to their being placed into production.
